risk_value_contract: Each of the three risk fields must be finite and lie in [0,1]; otherwise fail.
paired_native_rule: For each base_index, variant_index 0 is the unique native condition. Each variant 1..18 is paired only to that base_index's native condition.
dose_monotonicity_rule: For each family, compute the median InsePi risk across the 364 conditions independently at tier0, tier1 and tier2. The family is dose-monotone iff median_risk_tier0 <= median_risk_tier1 <= median_risk_tier2 exactly; no tolerance or fitted trend is used.
positive_high_tier_rule: A family counts positive iff median paired risk_delta at tier2 is strictly > 0.
global_high_tier_rule: Median paired risk_delta pooled across all 6*364 tier2 perturbed conditions.

allocation.paired_uniform_ratio_rule: Within each panel/budget/replicate, divide policy known-disturbance recall by the recall from uniform using the same selection seed. Regime-cell ratio is the arithmetic mean of the 200 replicate-level ratios, not ratio of means.
allocation.zero_uniform_recall_rule: fail; with balanced 182/364 truth and the preregistered budgets this is not expected and is not silently smoothed.
allocation.v6_allocation_pass: at least 45 of 54 regime cells pass and arithmetic mean of the 54 V6 cell ratios is strictly > 1.0
allocation.policy_ties: No winner claim is required. Report all six fixed policy results; V10 claim level depends only on frozen V6 versus paired uniform.

representation_tv.definition: 0.5 * sum(abs(selected category proportion - full-panel category proportion)) over the complete frozen category registry; categories absent from the selected set contribute zero selected mass, and categories absent from the full panel are impossible.

claim_precedence: A if positive_high_tier_family_count >= 5 AND dose_monotone_family_count >= 4 AND v6_allocation_pass
B if positive_high_tier_family_count >= 5 AND dose_monotone_family_count >= 4 AND NOT v6_allocation_pass
trace_truth_boundary: Observer result records may contain condition_index/id and observer outputs only. Family, tier, known_disturbed, video identity, temporal quartile and panel assignment are always joined from the frozen artifact registries by the evaluator after trace generation.
